pieces.text: No offer? No money. No options. Weak offer? You scrape by, sweat every bill. Good offer? Real profit, room to breathe. Grand Slam offer? Customers finance your growth — you finance your freedom. Your offer is the ceiling. On the business. On your life.

the truths I live by

1. Skills are the only real hedge. Markets crash and currencies die, but value always trades.
2. I'm married to the truth, not to being right.
3. Focus is nothing but the quantity of things you're willing to say no to. That's the whole game.
4. You don't get customers to make sales. You make sales to get customers.
5. Big goals come with big obstacles. If it were easy, someone smaller would've already done it.
6. A little bit done every day beats a lot done someday.
7. You need the bottom 10% of days to recognize the top 10%.
8. The lottery ticket is free. Keep cashing it in until you win.
9. Don't confuse what winners do now with what it took them to get there.
10. Nobody's coming to save you. Build like it's on you, because it is.

Let's be honest. You're not lazy. You're grinding 12 hours a day and going nowhere — that's not an effort problem, it's an aim problem. You don't need to do more work. You need to work on better problems.
